import json, os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT, read_json, write_json, file_sha256, machine_id, utc_now

run = 'resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v13'
batch = 'resumed-low-v13-auto-2-20261025'
commit = '8b625e5b7cd016cc23751af9c252cbe0eea69544'
state_path = ROOT / f'runtime/resume-low-20261025/publisher-{run}.json'
publication = ROOT / f'runtime/checkpoint-{batch}.json'
record_path = ROOT / 'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261026-v13-tail-publication-reconciled.json'
state, prior = read_json(state_path), read_json(publication)
assert prior['commit'] == commit and prior['status'] == 'push_pending_inspection_required'
assert state['original_deadline_utc'] == '2026-10-26T01:56:55.339093+00:00'
assert state['last_completed_requests'] == 27 and state['last_checkpoint_requests'] == 16
assert not (ROOT / 'runtime/production-publish.lock').exists()
assert not (state_path.parent / 'publisher.lock').exists()
remote = subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/master'], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120, check=True).stdout.split()[0]
failures = ROOT / 'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures'
saved = []
for source, suffix in [(publication, 'publication'), (state_path, 'publisher-state'), (record_path, 'prior-reconciliation-observation')]:
    target = failures / f'20261026-v13-tail-network-failure-original-{suffix}.json'
    with target.open('xb') as f:
        f.write(source.read_bytes())
    assert file_sha256(source) == file_sha256(target)
    saved.append({'path': target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), 'sha256': file_sha256(target), 'source_path': source.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()})
audit_path = failures / '20261026-v13-tail-network-failure.json'
assert not audit_path.exists()
audit = {'machine_id': machine_id(), 'observed_at_utc': utc_now(), 'actual_failed_unified_session_id': 65720, 'actual_failed_exit_code': 1, 'fixed_commit': commit, 'batch': batch, 'fresh_remote_master': remote, 'preserved_original_bytes': saved, 'retry_wrapper_process_id': os.getpid(), 'status': 'same_fixed_commit_git_only_retry_starting', 'scope': 'Actual push failed with connection reset, then localhost proxy connection failed. Fresh ordinary Git remote probe now succeeds. Retry the same immutable commit only. No image replay, checkpoint reconstruction, proxy/TLS/account change, force push, or deadline reset. Prior in-progress observation is preserved and superseded by actual exit 1.', 'source_code': Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')}
write_json(audit_path, audit)
state.update(status='fixed_tail_network_retry_running', observed_at_utc=utc_now(), network_failure_audit=audit_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
write_json(state_path, state)
print(json.dumps({'same_fixed_commit_retry_started': commit, 'fresh_remote_master': remote, 'process_id': os.getpid(), 'new_image_calls': 0}), flush=True)
result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-u', str(ROOT / 'tools/production_checkpoint_publish.py'), commit, batch], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace', timeout=2400)
audit.update(actual_retry_publisher_exit_code=result.returncode, completed_at_utc=utc_now(), actual_stdout=result.stdout, actual_stderr=result.stderr)
write_json(audit_path, audit)
if result.returncode:
    state.update(status='fixed_tail_network_retry_failed_requires_inspection', observed_at_utc=utc_now())
    write_json(state_path, state)
    print(json.dumps({'retry_exit_code': result.returncode, 'publication_status': read_json(publication).get('status'), 'error_tail': result.stderr[-3000:]}), flush=True)
    sys.exit(result.returncode)
pub = read_json(publication)
proof_path = ROOT / pub['remote_original_readback']
proof = read_json(proof_path)
assert pub['status'] == 'committed_pushed_and_originals_verified'
assert proof['status'] == 'verified' and proof['commit'] == commit
assert read_json(state_path) == state
record = {'machine_id': machine_id(), 'observed_at_utc': utc_now(), 'status': 'all_v13_tail_originals_and_tested_code_delivered_verified', 'publication_commit': commit, 'publication_status': pub['status'], 'readback_status': proof['status'], 'original_publisher_session_exit': {'session_id': 53670, 'exit_code': 1}, 'first_fixed_publication_exit': {'session_id': 65720, 'exit_code': 1}, 'retry_wrapper_process_id': os.getpid(), 'actual_retry_publisher_exit_code': 0, 'original_network_failure': audit_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), 'original_network_failure_sha256': file_sha256(audit_path), 'exact_union_reconciliation': 'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261026-v13-static-tail-index-union.json', 'tail_actual_full_readback': proof, 'tail_actual_full_readback_sha256': file_sha256(proof_path), 'v13_actual_calls': 27, 'v13_actual_original_PNGs': 26, 'v13_actual_refusals': 1, 'own_execution_originals_verified': 411, 'new_image_calls': 0, 'source_code': Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')}
write_json(record_path, record)
state.update(status='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline', last_checkpoint_requests=27, last_commit=commit, finished_at_utc=utc_now(), reconciliation=record_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), reconciliation_sha256=file_sha256(record_path))
write_json(state_path, state)
print(json.dumps({'reconciled': True, 'commit': commit, 'actual_verified_at_utc': proof['completed_at_utc'], 'own_execution_originals_verified': 411, 'original_git_deadline_utc': state['original_deadline_utc']}), flush=True)
